publication: A Study to Assess and Improve Dose Computations in Photon Beam Therapy
experimental_basis: ABB CH20 16 MV clinical beam spectrum numerically reconstructed from measured water depth-dose data. Measurements: SSD 100 cm, 10 x 10 cm2 field, silicon semiconductor diodes checked/confirmed with cylindrical ionisation chambers or parallel-plate chambers. Reconstruction uses Sauer-Neumann least-squares superposition of monoenergetic depth-dose curves.
published_numeric_location: Chapter 6, section 6.2.3; Figure 6.4 on thesis page 147 (PDF page 161), labelled ABB CH20, 16 MV spectrum; ordinate relative energy fluence (%/MeV).
notes: Figure 6.4 step curve digitized without smoothing. Raw digitized step integral=99.9386% (published total energy fluence is normalized to 100%). Uniform 0.1 MeV center representation is unit-area normalized for the frozen evaluator. Thesis reports no explicit uncertainty analysis for these reconstructions; it cites Sauer-Neumann method results indicating 1 s.d. energy-fluence uncertainty within about ±10% of the peak. Baker 1993 was rejected as 16 MV measured evidence because its NPL 16 MeV curve is EGS4 Monte Carlo.
